search_order: repository-local Lean source outside the target dossier and dependency cache
manifest-pinned mathlib source and its locally available immutable history
other public Lean 4 repositories at immutable revisions
historical Lean versions and other proof assistants as research-only evidence
the already preserved human primary source for unresolved source boundaries
aliases_and_translations: edge chromatic number equals maximum degree
chromatic index of a bipartite graph
declaration_and_api_queries: rg over repository-local *.lean for Konig/Koenig and edge-coloring/chromatic-index aliases
rg plus git tree/object inspection over pinned Mathlib/**/*.lean for aliases, Graph multigraph APIs, SimpleGraph coloring/line-graph APIs, Hall matching APIs, and terminal source bodies
Sourcegraph public streaming search with archived and forked repositories included for Lean declarations and theorem-name/text aliases
GitHub REST repository search for Konig edge coloring plus Lean/Lean4 aliases
GitHub REST code search for chromaticIndex, IsEdgeColouring, and bipartite edge coloring, retaining authentication failures
grep.app public code search for declaration aliases, retaining checkpoint/rate-limit failures
GitHub immutable commit/tree/raw-file APIs for any discovered Lean repository
immutable complete-tree and source inspection of formal-conjecture collections discovered or already available
research-only Sourcegraph/GitHub queries for Coq, Isabelle, HOL, and historical Lean artifacts

immutable_selection_rules.repo_local: bind results to the repository base revision and tree
immutable_selection_rules.mathlib: use only the lake-manifest pin and its clean checked-out tree; locally inspect history only when the referenced object is present and ancestry is recorded
immutable_selection_rules.external: resolve every moving ref to a full commit and tree before candidate classification; bind every inspected raw file to that commit, Git blob when available, and SHA-256
immutable_selection_rules.statement_collection: classify a proposition without a checked terminal proof body as statement-only even when it elaborates
immutable_selection_rules.other_assistant: classify non-Lean evidence as research-only and never as Lean 4 completion
immutable_selection_rules.negative_search: bind dated API responses or explicit access failures to SHA-256; a bounded no-match never proves global absence

credential_policy: Use unauthenticated public read APIs only. Do not expose credentials, clone or fetch dependencies, change Lake inputs, or mutate Formalizations/Lean/.lake. Record HTTP 401/403/429 and indexing limits rather than bypassing them.
network_policy: Network is used only for read-only discovery metadata and immutable raw-source inspection. Candidate elaboration uses the existing local pinned toolchain without dependency mutation.
expected_negative_evidence: HTTP/search status and bounded result count
response-body SHA-256 or explicit local rg exit status
access, shard-limit, indexing, archival, credential, and language-filter limitations
no saturation claim without independent reviewed saturation evidence
candidate_fields_required: project, canonical remote, commit, tree, and license
module, file, Git blob, source SHA-256, declaration, and fully elaborated type
toolchain, dependency pins, complete known dependency boundary, and local integration feasibility
normalized comparison with the full finite-bipartite-multigraph chromatic-index target
checked wrapper/conclusion versus terminal declaration and proof-body provenance
machine-produced axioms and selected foundation fit where directly checkable
parser/elaborator-aware placeholder, bodyless, unsafe, oracle, external-code, generated-artifact, and unknown-trust boundary
smallest direct check, M classification, evidence tier, integration blocker, and reopen condition
pre_protocol_inputs: The intake and statement dossiers already contained bounded repo-local and pinned-mathlib API probes. They are treated as discovery leads only and are re-run under this protocol; no earlier negative result is promoted to exhaustive evidence.
status_boundary: This protocol freezes one bounded anchor-discovery run. Classifying every resulting inventory member does not establish internet-wide absence, accepted machine closure, audit completion, or theorem completion.
